QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Plans from Heaven
QuestInfo.0: You took care of Il Capo, and now you should interrogate Zion. He was clearly confused as to where to turn. Question Zion.
QuestInfo.1: You took care of Il Capo, and now you should interrogate Zion. He was clearly confused as to where to turn. Question Zion.
QuestInfo.2: You took care of Il Capo, and interrogated Zion. He was clearly confused as to where to turn. Zion, scared as a mouse, revealed that the Heaven Empire is planning to isolate Commerci from the rest of the nations.
